CREATE TABLE business_receipts (
	command_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	external_id VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	source_revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	payload_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	payload JSON NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	site_id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	scope_line_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (command_id, source_revision), 
	FOREIGN KEY(command_id) REFERENCES business_commands (id)
)

sqlite.name: inventory_reservations
sqlite.create:
CREATE TABLE inventory_reservations (
	plan_id VARCHAR(64), 
	inventory_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	quantity NUMERIC(28, 9) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	command_id VARCHAR(64), 
	source_reference VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	site_id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	scope_line_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CHECK (quantity > 0), 
	FOREIGN KEY(plan_id) REFERENCES supply_plans (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(inventory_id) REFERENCES inventory_snapshots (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(command_id) REFERENCES business_commands (id)
)

postgresql.name: formulation_calculations

postgresql.name: policy_decisions

)

	reasons JSON NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	site_id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,

	scope_line_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,

)

postgresql.name: quality_assessments
postgresql.create:
CREATE TABLE quality_assessments (
	definition_id VARCHAR(64), 
	method_id VARCHAR(64), 
	plan_id VARCHAR(64), 
	object_id VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	granularity VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	product_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	process VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	step_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	outcome VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	source_kind VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	source_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	source_version VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	original_value TEXT NOT NULL, 
	value NUMERIC(28, 9), 
	unit VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	occurred_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	author_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	snapshot JSON NOT NULL, 
	reasons JSON NOT NULL, 
	supersedes_id VARCHAR(64), 
	id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	site_id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	scope_line_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CHECK (outcome IN ('pass','fail','not_tested','invalid','review')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(definition_id) REFERENCES decision_definitions (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(method_id) REFERENCES decision_definitions (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(plan_id) REFERENCES decision_definitions (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(supersedes_id) REFERENCES quality_assessments (id)
)

postgresql.name: supply_plans
postgresql.create:
CREATE TABLE supply_plans (

)

postgresql.name: bom_components
postgresql.create:
CREATE TABLE bom_components (
	bom_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	material_id VARCHAR(64), 
	child_bom_id VARCHAR(64), 
	quantity NUMERIC(28, 9) NOT NULL, 
	unit VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	loss_fraction NUMERIC(28, 9) NOT NULL, 
	conversion_factor NUMERIC(28, 9) NOT NULL, 
	conversion_basis VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	site_id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	scope_line_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CHECK ((material_id IS NULL) <> (child_bom_id IS NULL)), 
	CHECK (quantity > 0), 
	FOREIGN KEY(bom_id) REFERENCES bills_of_materials (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(material_id) REFERENCES material_items (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(child_bom_id) REFERENCES bills_of_materials (id)
)

postgresql.name: business_order_lines

postgresql.name: digital_tasks

	actor_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

	actor_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	policy_id VARCHAR(64), 
	approval_id VARCHAR(64), 
	target_id VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	target_version VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	input_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

	snapshot JSON NOT NULL,
